entries.condition: still_grid vs reference_a; landmarks in metrics.json
entries.evidence: Horizon at y=0.212-0.235 vs reference 0.25; plane centroid (0.80,0.76) vs (0.813,0.752) and width 0.135 vs 0.1325; bridge start (0.418,0.512)/end (0.681,0.345) vs (0.395,0.475)/(0.735,0.325) so the island-to-upper-right direction matches; but the main island is a thin horizontal strip spanning x=0.05-0.98 at y=0.50-0.72 instead of the reference island filling the lower-left (x 0.18-0.56, y 0.55-0.92) and rows 7-8 are empty water.
entries.defect: Camera is too far/high from the island so the foreground sand flats and lagoon of the reference are replaced by 28% of frame of open water, and cloud cover is 18% vs 39%.
entries.fix: Move the camera ~40% closer and lower toward the island tip, enlarge the island footprint toward the camera, and add a second cumulus bank across C1-E2.

entries.condition: still_grid + crops/aircraft.png, blind outline comparison with reference floatplane
entries.evidence: High-wing, radial cowl, twin floats with spreader bars and a swept fin read as a Beaver at a glance; the fin is a thin tapered blade with a dark tip and the horizontal tail span is ~55% of the wing chord region, wider than the reference, and the wing is a constant-thickness plate with no dihedral.
entries.defect: Tail surfaces are oversized and the wing has no dihedral/washout so the outline is 'toy Beaver' rather than DHC-2.
entries.fix: Reduce horizontal stabiliser span ~15%, thicken the fin root, add 1-2 deg dihedral and a visible wing-strut pair.

entries.condition: crops/aircraft.png at 324 px crop, edge inspection
entries.evidence: Floats, N-struts, spreader bars, prop disc, fin and stabiliser are present and nothing intersects; the fuselage is a smooth tapered tube with no door, no steps, no aileron/flap seams; registration N726BV on the visible starboard side is rendered mirrored (glyphs flipped).
entries.defect: Mirrored registration texture on the starboard fuselage and absent control-surface seams.
entries.fix: Flip the UVs on the starboard decal (or use a separate unmirrored decal) and add flap/aileron gap lines to the wing.

entries.condition: projected span fraction vs reference_a.json aircraft.widthFraction
entries.evidence: Plane spans ~0.135 of frame width vs reference 0.1325 and sits at (0.80,0.76) vs (0.813,0.752); relative to the shore trees (~1/6 of the span vs ~1/4 in the reference) it reads slightly large against the world.
entries.defect: Aircraft-to-world scale slightly off because trees are undersized, not because the aircraft is.
entries.fix: Scale tree canopies up ~30% or place the camera closer so shore objects read at reference scale.

entries.condition: crops/aircraft.png, sun high behind-left
entries.evidence: Airframe is a uniform matte white (135-230 grey) with navy wingtips; no specular lobe on cowl, wing or floats, no panel lines, no weathering, and the reference's yellow (239,199,90) belly/cowl livery is absent.
entries.defect: Uniform roughness/albedo over the whole aircraft with no specular response.
entries.fix: Assign a clearcoat metal-paint material with roughness 0.25-0.35, add panel-line/rivet normal map and the yellow-white livery.

entries.condition: crops/aircraft.png cabin windows and windshield
entries.evidence: Cabin windows and windshield are flat dark-navy decals with no transparency, no reflection of sky and no interior visible.
entries.defect: Glass rendered as opaque dark paint.
entries.fix: Use a transparent glass material with Fresnel reflection and a simple interior (seats, panel) behind it.

entries.condition: still_grid + crops/distant.png
entries.evidence: Two downtown clusters (~40 box towers each) plus a suburb of identical small grey cubes at A3-B3; towers are flat-shaded prisms in grey/white/blue with no facade texture, no glass reflection and identical crispness front to back; the reference has one hazy skyline with varied tower shapes.
entries.defect: Prism towers with untextured faces and a second duplicate downtown.
entries.fix: Add window-grid facade textures with emissive/reflective glass, vary footprints and remove or shrink the second downtown.

entries.condition: still_grid, crops/environment.png, zoom on A6/B5 tip
entries.evidence: Islands are perfectly flat; the coast is a uniform-width grey-lavender band (not sand beige 184,167,148) with white speckle dots; the west tip ends in a straight-edged angular grey spit at A6/B5; the mainland is a flat untextured green plane to the horizon.
entries.defect: Uniform-width beach band and an angular slab-like spit replace the reference's irregular sand flats and shoals.
entries.fix: Generate beaches from a noise-driven distance field with variable width, add sandbars/shoals in the shallows, and give islands 2-5 m of relief.

entries.condition: row-mean water colour, still_grid
entries.evidence: Water grades from hazy (166,191,211) at y=0.24 to saturated cyan (9,142,192) at y=0.9 and lightens in the lagoon (131,192,216); the near water is an electric cyan far from the reference teal (80,148,171) and the foreground rows 7-8 show only soft blotches with no wave structure or depth-dependent colour.
entries.defect: Oversaturated near water and a near-featureless foreground plane.
entries.fix: Desaturate deep water toward (60,140,175), add depth-based absorption using a bathymetry texture and a normal-mapped wave field.

entries.condition: still_grid, all water regions
entries.evidence: No reflection of the aircraft, bridge, towers, boats or clouds anywhere, no sun glitter, and the lagoon shows no sky reflection.
entries.defect: Water has no reflection term.
entries.fix: Add planar or SSR reflection blended by Fresnel plus a sun specular lobe.

entries.condition: still_grid zooms on boats
entries.evidence: Boat at G8 is a dark blob with no wake; tiny grey boats at E3/F4 have no wakes; ~12 identical sailboats sit in one evenly spaced straight row at the E5 shore; the reference shows three speedboats with long bright V-wakes.
entries.defect: No wakes or hull-water interaction on any boat; marina row is evenly spaced clones.
entries.fix: Add wake meshes/foam trails to moving boats and jitter marina boat positions, headings and hull types.

entries.condition: crops/environment.png, tree zoom at E6
entries.evidence: Vegetation is two models (round lollipop canopy and palm) repeated hundreds of times at identical size on a flat bright lawn (75,131,104); canopy colour ~ (70-95,127-150) is far brighter than the reference (81,85,74); no continuous forest canopy, no undergrowth.
entries.defect: Clone trees at identical scale with cartoon colour.
entries.fix: Use 6-8 tree variants with random scale 0.7-1.4 and yaw, darker desaturated canopy colours, and cluster them into a dense forest with overlapping canopies.

entries.condition: still_grid, crops/medium.png, crops/distant.png
entries.evidence: Main bridge runs from the island (0.418,0.512) to the upper-right (0.681,0.345), matching the reference direction; but it is a thin deck at water level with a stippled dashed surface, a short two-rib arch with ~10 piers in the middle and no visible supports along the remaining ~80%; the second bridge at bridge2End (0.867,0.345) is a small arch on a straight grey band.
entries.defect: Bridge deck sits on the water with no piers so it reads as a floating strip.
entries.fix: Raise the deck 15-25 m on regularly spaced piers reaching the water, make the arch a full-height tied arch and add deck traffic.

entries.condition: zoom on cloud bands
entries.evidence: Both cloud masses are stippled point sprays with visible individual dots, uniform grey-white with no lit top or shaded base and a grey haze band underneath; cover ~18% vs reference 39%.
entries.defect: Dithered particle clouds with no volume shading.
entries.fix: Replace with volumetric or billboard-cluster cumulus with sun-facing highlight and ambient-shaded base, doubling the cover.

entries.condition: horizon zoom, crops/distant.png
entries.evidence: Far water pales toward (166,191,211) and towers desaturate, but the horizon is a razor-straight seam where the flat green plane meets sky (A3-D3) with no haze blend, and back-row towers keep the same contrast as front-row ones.
entries.defect: Hard horizon seam and haze that does not scale with distance inside the skyline.
entries.fix: Apply exponential height fog with a horizon blend and fade the ground plane into the sky colour over the last 5% of depth.

entries.condition: sky/water/aircraft colour sampling
entries.evidence: Sun is high behind-left (fuselage port side lit, starboard shaded), matching the reference; but sky top is grey (108,131,148) vs reference (55,134,180), horizon sky is near-white (212,221,227), while water is oversaturated, giving a milky low-contrast scene.
entries.defect: Exposure/sky model washes the sky while water stays saturated.
entries.fix: Use a physical sky with deeper zenith blue and lower exposure by ~0.3 EV; tone-map with a filmic curve.

entries.condition: tree/building base inspection
entries.evidence: No cast shadows from trees, houses, towers, boats or the bridge on ground or water; only the aircraft has self-shading.
entries.defect: Shadow casting absent for the world.
entries.fix: Enable cascaded shadow maps for terrain objects with a 2-3 cascade setup.

entries.condition: specular inspection on aircraft and water
entries.evidence: No specular highlight on the white airframe, no sun glitter on the water, no reflections.
entries.defect: Specular term effectively missing.
entries.fix: Add sun specular to water and clearcoat specular to the aircraft.

entries.condition: dominant colour comparison with reference_a.json
entries.evidence: Water (9,142,192) vs reference (80,148,171); lawn (75,131,104) vs vegetation (81,85,74); sky top (108,131,148) vs (55,134,180); sand grey-lavender vs warm beige (184,167,148).
entries.defect: Saturated cartoon palette instead of the reference's muted filmic grade.
entries.fix: Apply a LUT that desaturates greens/cyans by ~30% and warms the sand.

entries.condition: still_grid vs flight.png (frame 90)
entries.evidence: World is static between frames (same clouds, boats moved ~35 px), no shimmer or popping visible; the plane moved from (0.80,0.76) to (0.305,0.338) while the HUD did not change.
entries.defect: HUD frozen between frames; otherwise stable.
entries.fix: Drive the HUD from the live telemetry each frame.

entries.condition: flight.png, telemetry heading 326->311, FIXED camera
entries.evidence: Fixed camera lets the plane leave the composition and become a speck at (0.305,0.338) by frame 90; heading changed 15 deg with no visible bank; still pose is wings-level whereas the reference banks 8-10 deg left.
entries.defect: Camera does not follow and the aircraft turns without banking.
entries.fix: Use a chase camera with lag and couple roll to yaw rate in the flight model.

entries.condition: count of distinct objects per region
entries.evidence: Two downtowns, suburb field, five islands, marina, two bridges and a few boats exist, but the island interior is a road grid with ~8 houses and empty lots, roads dead-end at the lagoon sand, no traffic on the bridge and no people.
entries.defect: Sparse, unanchored props on an empty grid.
entries.fix: Fill the grid with houses, add cars on roads/bridge and moving boats with wakes.

entries.condition: near vs far detail
entries.evidence: Near-island trees are individually modelled while far islands use the same dot-style trees; far towers are as crisp as near ones with no LOD softening; the aircraft has far more detail than any world object.
entries.defect: No distance-based softening; detail budget concentrated on the aircraft.
entries.fix: Add atmospheric softening and lower-frequency impostors for far trees/towers.

entries.condition: instance repetition inspection
entries.evidence: Same tree model repeated hundreds of times, 12 identical sailboats evenly spaced at E5, identical suburb cubes at A3-B3, two near-identical downtown clusters.
entries.defect: Clone trees/boats/buildings and evenly spaced objects.
entries.fix: Randomise scale/rotation/colour per instance and vary building footprints.

entries.condition: artifact scan of every cell + console.txt

entries.defect: Dithering, speckle noise and a hard seam are visible in ordinary play.
entries.fix: Fix the decal UVs, replace stipple clouds, replace foam dots with a shoreline foam texture, fix the missing resource.

entries.condition: HUD legibility and update check

entries.defect: HUD does not update with telemetry.
entries.fix: Bind HUD fields to the simulation state each frame.

entries.condition: metrics.json counters (frame times come from a CPU software renderer and are ignored)
entries.evidence: 1295 draw calls, 9.87 M triangles, 634 geometries, 41 textures, 40 programs; JS heap 143 MB still / 138 MB flight.
entries.defect: ~10 M triangles and ~1300 draw calls per frame exceed a comfortable browser budget (1-3 M tris, <500 calls) and heap swings suggest allocation churn.
entries.fix: Instance trees/buildings, add LODs and merge static geometry to cut calls below 500 and triangles below 3 M.

entries.condition: still_grid vs flight.png chase camera, telemetry heading 96->100, altitude 52->40 m

entries.defect: Chase camera does not damp yaw/pitch and loses the subject and the landmark.
entries.fix: Use a spring-damped follow camera locked to the velocity vector with a max pitch offset of ~10 deg, and derive V/S from the simulation.

entries.condition: artifact scan of every cell

Bridge deck as a water-level wall with hairline arch ribs and no piers (C8-E8, D2)

entries.condition: crops/aircraft.png material response with the sun high behind the camera
entries.evidence: Wing top, flaps, fuselage and floats share one matte response (~200-215 grey on the wing, uniform navy on floats) with no highlight on the sunlit upper surfaces; only faint panel lines and yellow flap-hinge strips break the uniformity.
entries.defect: Uniform roughness across the whole aircraft.
entries.fix: Use a clearcoat paint material (roughness 0.25-0.35) with per-panel roughness variation and a rivet/panel normal map.

entries.condition: float/water interaction scan in still and flight; boat dots at E2-F2
entries.evidence: Floats hang 5.5 m over glassy ripples with no disturbance, the frame that should show touchdown spray has no aircraft in it, and the three boat dots at E2-F2 leave no wakes; the only mark on the water is a flat yellow quad at E4.
entries.defect: No hull-water interaction is demonstrated anywhere in the landing view.
entries.fix: Add spray/wake particle emitters on float contact and wake trails on boats; keep the camera on the plane at touchdown.

entries.condition: shore2x crop of the bridge line at row 2
entries.evidence: The bridge is a 1-2 px grey deck line at water level across the whole frame width with two hairline arches at D2-E2 and F2 and no visible piers or approach ramps.
entries.defect: Bridge reads as a wire on the water rather than a pier-supported structure.
entries.fix: Raise the deck on piers reaching the water and give the arch ribs real thickness so they survive at distance.

entries.condition: still_grid vs flight.png, 90 frames apart
entries.evidence: Camera orientation swings from looking down at the plane (horizon y=0.17) to looking up at the sky (horizon y=0.80) with the subject gone; HUD stays at 48 kt / 18 ft / +400 / 086 while telemetry reads 35 kt / 6 ft / 077; water and clouds themselves show no shimmer or popping.
entries.defect: Camera instability and a frozen HUD dominate the temporal behaviour.
entries.fix: Damp the camera and bind HUD fields to live telemetry each frame.

entries.condition: still_grid vs flight.png; telemetry altitude 5.5 m -> 1.96 m onWater, heading 86 -> 77, airspeed 24.5 -> 18.2 m/s
entries.evidence: At frame 90 the chase camera has pitched up so the horizon sits at y=0.805 and the aircraft is not in the frame at all (planeCentroid null); the touchdown happens unseen; the still shows a flaps-down approach at 18 ft with the HUD reading V/S +400.
entries.defect: Chase camera loses the aircraft completely during the landing and V/S is not derived from the simulation.
entries.fix: Lock the chase camera to the aircraft position with a spring-damped offset behind the velocity vector, clamp pitch, and compute V/S from altitude rate.

entries.cells: A2-H2 horizon, E4, C5-F6, G3-H4, HUD

entries.condition: plane2x crop, backlit by a low sun ahead of the aircraft
entries.evidence: The whole airframe is a uniform matte blue-grey (wing top ~ (68,82,126)); no rim highlight along the fuselage spine, cowl or wing leading edge and no glint on the navy floats although the sun is 10 deg above the horizon ahead.
entries.defect: Uniform roughness with no specular response to a grazing light.
entries.fix: Use a clearcoat paint material so the low sun produces rim highlights and float glints.

entries.condition: boat/wake scan across the whole water surface

entries.condition: islands2x and bridge_mid2x crops

entries.defect: Bridge supports missing along most of the span.
entries.fix: Add regularly spaced piers reaching the water along the whole deck and give the arch ribs structural thickness.

entries.condition: cloud3x crop and flight_sky strip

entries.defect: Dithered particle clouds with no volume shading at the one time of day when cloud lighting is most visible.
entries.fix: Replace with shaded billboard clusters or volumetrics; light the sun-facing rim warm and the base cool at low sun angles.

entries.condition: long-shadow check at 17:53 sun elevation
entries.evidence: With the sun 10 deg above the horizon, trees on the islands and lamp posts on the deck cast no shadows on the lawn or deck; only the lit/unlit split on the fuselage suggests a direction.
entries.defect: World shadow casting absent at the time of day when shadows dominate the look.
entries.fix: Enable shadow maps for vegetation and infrastructure with a long-shadow cascade.

entries.condition: artifact scan of every cell in still_grid and flight.png

entries.condition: water colour vs sky colour
entries.evidence: Open water is a saturated cyan (33,130,161) under a grey sky; the shallows gradient near the beach (B6-C7) and the pale lagoon are good, but the deep water carries no grey sky reflection and no wave-scale change with distance.
entries.defect: Water colour disconnected from the sky it should reflect.
entries.fix: Drive the water base colour from the sky radiance and add depth-based absorption.

entries.condition: reflection scan of lagoon, marina basin and bay
entries.evidence: No reflection of the grey sky, trees, marina boats or the aircraft anywhere; the lagoon is a flat pale wash.
entries.defect: Water reflection term missing.
entries.fix: Add planar/SSR reflections blended by Fresnel.

entries.condition: bridge2x crop
entries.evidence: The deck lies at water level from the island to the far shore with piers visible only under the hairline arch at F3-G3; red dots along the deck read as lights but there is no structure below the deck.
entries.defect: Bridge supports missing along most of the span.
entries.fix: Add piers reaching the water along the whole deck and thicken the arch ribs.

entries.condition: cloud3x crop of the sky band and flight_top strip
entries.evidence: The overcast is a grey-blue gradient with sprayed bands of individual white dots; there is no cloud base texture, no soft stratus layer, no variation in thickness and no volume, and the dot grain is visible at 1x in flight.png.
entries.defect: The 'cloudy' condition is represented by particle stipple rather than a cloud layer.
entries.fix: Render an overcast layer as a textured/volumetric stratus deck with a noise-driven base and let it drive ambient light.

entries.condition: sky colour vs surface lighting comparison
entries.evidence: Sky zenith is grey (85,104,125) yet the fuselage shows a clear lit/shaded side split, the lawn is a saturated bright green, the beach is bright and the water is a sunny cyan (33,130,161); nothing in the scene responds to the overcast.
entries.defect: Lighting model ignores the sky condition; only the sky layer changed.
entries.fix: Scale direct sun intensity by cloud cover, raise ambient/sky light and desaturate water reflection colour from the sky.

entries.condition: instance repetition scan
entries.evidence: Round lollipop trees and palms repeat at identical size across the whole island, the mainland is a carpet of identical grey cubes to the horizon, marina piers are evenly spaced with the same hull models.
entries.defect: Clone trees/buildings and evenly spaced marina piers.
entries.fix: Randomise per-instance scale/yaw/colour, vary building footprints and jitter pier spacing/hull types.

entries.fix: Add nav/strobe/landing lights with emissive meshes and light the airframe from them; use a clearcoat paint material.

entries.condition: water colour vs lighting condition

entries.defect: Water colour ignores the night lighting.

entries.cells: D3-F4 below the skyline, G3-H4 quay, E3-E7

entries.defect: Water reflection term missing at the time of day when light reflections are the primary cue.

entries.condition: cloud3x crop of the night sky band

entries.condition: exposure/lighting check for 22:00 with no moon visible
entries.evidence: Islands are green with pale beach rims, the water is a lit teal (54,92,114), the airframe shows a daylight lit/shaded split (fuselage 119,126,136) and the shallows wash is visible, while the sky is slate (51,71,107); city windows are pure white dots with no glow or light pools.
entries.defect: Night is rendered as an under-exposed dusk with a directional sun still on.
entries.fix: Switch to a moon/sky-lit night model: drop direct light to a weak cool moonlight, crush the water and terrain toward near-black blue, add bloom and warm/cool window emissives with ground light pools.

entries.condition: specular scan of water and aircraft

entries.condition: still_grid outline vs DHC-2 rear three-quarter reference
entries.evidence: High wing, twin floats with spreader bars, N-struts and a tapered rear fuselage read as a floatplane, but the vertical tail is a tall rectangular plate whose ventral part below the fuselage is as large as the dorsal fin (B4-C6, 0.25 of frame height), the wing is a constant-thickness slab with square tips and no dihedral, and the rounded Beaver fin/rudder outline is absent.
entries.defect: Tail proportions and the slab wing make the outline read as a generic high-wing model rather than a DHC-2.
entries.fix: Rebuild the fin/rudder with the Beaver's rounded outline and a small triangular seaplane ventral fin, give the wing an airfoil section, rounded tips and 1-2 deg dihedral.

entries.condition: fuselage2x, tail2x, floats2x, wingtip3x crops
entries.evidence: Registration N726BV and the 'Bahia Vista Air' slogan are mirrored on the port side; the fin is a single flat plate ~2 px thick seen edge-on; the wing tip is a squared slab with a flat green disc as the nav light; the floats hover ~1 m above the water with the ripple pattern visible beneath them and no waterline; a yellow tag on a string hangs in mid-air from the fuselage at F5; on the plus side the floats carry cleats, stern caps and water rudders and a boarding step exists.

entries.fix: Unmirror the port decal UVs, model the fin with thickness and an airfoil, place the floats at their waterline with the hull bottom below the surface, attach the mooring line to a dock cleat or remove it.

entries.cells: B4-H7 vs B3-C4 boats and piers

entries.cells: D4-E5 fuselage, C4-H4 wing, B4-C6 fin, D6-F7 floats

entries.defect: Spinner, prop and slab wing/fin break the outline on closer inspection.
entries.fix: Use the Beaver's blunt spinner/hub, a complete three-blade prop, an airfoil wing section and the rounded fin outline.

entries.cells: A4-G6 fuselage, E2-H2 wing, E7-H8 floats, D7-G8 struts
entries.condition: nose_left, wingreg2x and water3x crops; 15:30 sun behind the aircraft
entries.evidence: The fuselage skin carries rivet dimples along curved panel lines with a soft ambient gradient and a red/navy/yellow cheatline, the best surface detail of the round; but the white reads blue (142,180,211) with no sky reflection or clearcoat highlight, the yellow wing underside is one flat colour with faint noise, floats and struts are uniform matte grey and the keel plate, pillars and plank are unlit pure black.

entries.fix: Apply a clearcoat paint material to all painted parts, give the black plates a shaded material and add subtle exhaust and water staining on the floats.

entries.condition: glass2x, windshield and f_glass2x crops; sun at 15:30
entries.evidence: The windshield and side windows are a uniform navy (56,98,153) identical to the roof paint so no pane edge, frame or thickness is visible; there is no sky or sun reflection, no Fresnel falloff and no refraction of the interior; behind the tint the pilot is a beige sphere with a torus headset, the seats are a blue block and pink translucent boxes, and no panel, yoke or windshield posts exist.
entries.defect: Glass reads as opaque tinted paint over a placeholder interior in the dedicated glass view.
entries.fix: Use a transparent glass material with environment reflection, 20-30% tint and Fresnel, model the window frames, and build a low-poly cockpit with panel, yokes, seats and a pilot figure.

entries.cells: C3-F4 roof, D6-H8 water, E7-H8 floats
entries.condition: shadow scan at 15:30 with the sun behind the aircraft
entries.evidence: The wing casts no shadow on the roof or glass, the fuselage and keel plate cast none on the floats, the struts cast none on the float decks and the aircraft casts no shadow on the calm water at G5-H8.
entries.defect: Neither cast nor self-shadowing on the aircraft or the water.
entries.fix: Enable shadow casting and receiving for the aircraft with a high-resolution near cascade and let the water receive shadows.

entries.cells: B3-F4 glass, A4-G6 fuselage, D6-H8 water
entries.condition: specular and reflection scan
entries.evidence: No specular highlight anywhere on the airframe, the glass reflects nothing and the water beside and beneath the floats shows no reflection of the floats, struts or fuselage; the struts have only Lambert cylinder shading.
entries.defect: Reflections and specular are missing under the one condition this view is designed to test.
entries.fix: Add environment reflection on glass and paint, planar reflection on the near water and a sun specular lobe.

entries.condition: artifact scan of every cell in still_grid and flight.png
entries.evidence: A detached livery box floating under the belly, a serrated z-fighting line where the keel plate meets the belly band, floats with the water surface visible under their bellies, mirrored registration and slogan text in four places, stair-step aliasing on the strut end caps, a 1-px horizon seam with horizontal streak moire in the far water and stipple-grain clouds.
entries.defect: Floating geometry, z-fighting and mirrored decals on the hero asset at inspection range.
entries.fix: Fix the placard, offset the keel plate, place the floats, unmirror the decals, cap the struts smoothly, fog the horizon and replace the cloud stipple.

worst3: Opaque navy glass with no sun or sky reflection over a sphere-headed pilot and box seats (B3-F4)
A box wearing the fuselage livery floats detached under the belly (A8-B8) and the keel plate z-fights with the belly band (E6-F6)
Floats visible above the water with no waterline, shadow or reflection (E7-H8)
best3: Rivet dimples and curved panel lines on the fuselage skin (A4-B6)
Complete float rigging: N-struts, spreader bars, cleats and stern caps with smooth shading (D7-H8)
Elevated bridge on regular piers with lamp posts and traffic at A3-B3 and a hazed skyline at F2-G3
